record.description_evidence:
Dictus is a voice keyboard that types what you say. Tap the mic, speak, and your words appear in any app. Everything runs on your iPhone.

WORKS COMPLETELY OFFLINE

Speech recognition happens on your device, powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. No internet required. No servers involved. Dictate on a plane, in the subway, anywhere.

YOUR VOICE STAYS YOURS

Nothing ever leaves your iPhone. No account. No tracking. No analytics. The microphone is used for one thing: turning your speech into text, locally.

OPEN SOURCE AND VERIFIABLE

Dictus is fully open source (MIT license). Anyone can read the code and verify these privacy claims. You do not have to trust us. You can check.

github.com/getdictus/dictus-ios

A REAL KEYBOARD

Dictus is also a complete keyboard: type when you want, talk when you do not. Autocorrect, suggestions, emoji search, and a mic key always one tap away.

DICTATE IN FAR MORE THAN FOUR LANGUAGES

The keyboard itself is built for four: French, English, German and Spanish, with the right layout, autocorrect and suggestions for each.

Dictation goes much further. Parakeet, the default model, transcribes 25 European languages and detects which one you are speaking. The Whisper models reach close to a hundred. Every model tells you which languages it handles well before you download it.

CHOOSE YOUR MODEL

Pick the model that fits your iPhone, from compact and fast to maximum accuracy. Download once, use forever, stored locally.

Dictus collects no data. Privacy policy: getdictus.com/privacy
